reviewPolicy: Every event below has time.start, time.end, and timelineNodes. FSN dates are relative-only because the source summaries provide route days but not calendar dates.

timelineNodes.label: summons occur
timelineNodes.summary: Kiritsugu summons Saber; Tokiomi summons Archer; Waver summons Rider; Kariya summons Berserker.

timelineNodes.label: contracts established
timelineNodes.summary: The source line groups the summonings as a simultaneous war setup event.

timelineNodes.label: summoning event closed
timelineNodes.summary: Four Master/Servant pairs are established.

events.cause: Fourth Holy Grail War summoning phase.
events.outcome: Core Fourth War teams are established.

timelineNodes.label: command issued
timelineNodes.summary: Saber is commanded to destroy the Grail.

timelineNodes.label: Grail destruction
timelineNodes.summary: The Grail is destroyed by command.

timelineNodes.label: war ends
timelineNodes.summary: The Fourth Holy Grail War ends.

events.process: Kiritsugu uses command authority through Saber.
events.outcome: Fourth War ends and leads toward the Fuyuki fire aftermath.

end.relative: FSN common route day 3 night after Lancer is repelled

timelineNodes.label: Lancer pursues Shirou
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou is chased home by Lancer.

timelineNodes.label: Saber summoned
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou summons Saber from danger.

timelineNodes.label: Lancer repelled
timelineNodes.summary: Saber repels Lancer and the common route war structure begins.

events.cause: Lancer attempts to eliminate Shirou as witness.
events.outcome: Shirou becomes a Master and Saber enters the Fifth War.

timelineNodes.label: Ryuudouji final battle
timelineNodes.summary: Saber fights Gilgamesh and Shirou fights Kirei.

timelineNodes.label: Avalon and Azoth resolutions
timelineNodes.summary: Saber uses Avalon against Ea and Shirou defeats Kirei with the Azoth sword.

timelineNodes.label: Grail destroyed and Saber departs
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou commands Saber to destroy the polluted Grail; Saber confesses and disappears.

events.cause: Polluted Grail and final antagonist confrontation.
events.process: Parallel duels conclude with Grail destruction.
events.outcome: Fate route Holy Grail War ends and Saber returns to Camlann.

timelineNodes.label: Archer turns on Shirou
timelineNodes.summary: Archer attempts to kill Shirou after the Caster confrontation.

timelineNodes.label: Unlimited Blade Works opened
timelineNodes.summary: Archer opens Unlimited Blade Works and Shirou counters by projection.

timelineNodes.label: future self revealed
timelineNodes.summary: Archer is revealed as future Emiya Shirou and the next-day duel is set.

events.outcome: Shirou/Archer ideological duel becomes the route axis.

timelineNodes.label: Ryuudouji final battle begins
timelineNodes.summary: Saber fights Assassin and Rin moves to rescue Shinji.

timelineNodes.label: UBW counters Gate of Babylon
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou opens Unlimited Blade Works against Gilgamesh.

timelineNodes.label: Archer shoots Gilgamesh
timelineNodes.summary: Archer manifests and shoots Gilgamesh before farewell.

events.cause: Final Grail vessel crisis with Gilgamesh and Shinji.
events.process: Saber, Rin, Shirou, and Archer resolve the final conflict.
events.outcome: Gilgamesh is defeated and Archer departs reconciled.

start.relative: HF route day 10 Einzbern castle battle

timelineNodes.label: castle battle crisis
timelineNodes.summary: Black Shadow, True Assassin, and Saber Alter attack during the Einzbern castle battle.

timelineNodes.label: Archer shields Rin and Shirou loses arm
timelineNodes.summary: Archer takes fatal damage and Shirou's left arm is destroyed.

timelineNodes.label: Archer arm transplanted
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou receives Archer's arm under Kirei's treatment and the shroud seal.

events.cause: HF castle attack and Black Shadow escalation.
events.process: Archer's fatal injury becomes the source of Shirou's transplanted arm.
events.outcome: Shirou gains dangerous access to Archer's power at severe cost.

start.relative: HF route day 16 cavern final battle

end.relative: HF route day 16 Grail resolution branch

timelineNodes.label: Great Cavern final battle
timelineNodes.summary: Rider fights Saber Alter while Shirou supports with Rho Aias.

timelineNodes.label: Rule Breaker cuts Avenger contract
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou projects Rule Breaker and stabs Sakura to cut the Avenger contract.

timelineNodes.label: Sakura cleansed and Grail resolution begins
timelineNodes.summary: Sakura is purified; Rider evacuates Rin and Sakura while Shirou remains to destroy the Greater Grail.

events.cause: HF final confrontation with Black Sakura and the Greater Grail.
events.process: Rider and Shirou defeat Saber Alter, Rin confronts Sakura, and Shirou severs Sakura's contract with Avenger.
events.outcome: Sakura is purified and the ending branch begins.
